title: Print two words
instruction: Use a single print() to output **Hello Python**.
test_suite:
import io, sys
import re

def t1():
    captured = io.StringIO()
    sys.stdout = captured
    exec(open("exercise.py").read())
    sys.stdout = sys.__stdout__
    output = captured.getvalue()
    assert output == "Hello Python\n"
